units.source_text: 我用这种残酷的语言来迎接母亲，心里沾沾自喜。

en.t: I greeted my mother with these cruel words, secretly pleased with myself.

units.source_text: 然而母亲却像往常一样，没有任何感受，也没有任何抵触，实是令人心里恼很。

en.t: Yet my mother, as usual, showed no feeling at all and no resistance whatsoever, which was truly infuriating.

units.source_text: 可话又说回来，如果母亲超过门坎来到我的中间，那么连想像我都觉得太可怕了。

en.t: But then again, if my mother had crossed the threshold and come into my inner world, even imagining it seemed too terrifying.
